name: tugite
description: Use v5 impl-lead, plan-craft, plan-craft-approval, review-loop, and clarify-it with internal skills, Work Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors while the parent Codex agent owns planning, QA, and final verification.

interface.shortDescription: Install agents and delegate with parent QA.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for the v5 public workflows impl-lead, plan-craft, plan-craft-approval, review-loop, and clarify-it, their internal skills, Work Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors. Clarify-it also applies when a user clearly wants step-by-step clarification, and returns the reintegrated current decision model without follow-up actions. The parent Codex agent performs parent QA and keeps final quality responsibility.
defaultPrompt: Use $clarify-it when explicitly requested or when the user clearly wants step-by-step clarification; return the reintegrated current decision model without editing artifacts, implementing, or starting follow-up actions.
Use $plan-craft to draft or refine a free-form planning artifact without starting implementation.
Use $plan-craft-approval to draft a human-directed planning artifact through gate and fixed review without starting implementation.
Use $review-loop to review an immutable artifact snapshot with bounded rounds and caller-owned acceptance evidence.
Use $impl-lead to run bounded Work Unit implementation loops with parent QA.
Use $install-custom-agents to check, install, or update the bundled custom agents.
